Hey there. My name is Jacques Mienie AKA Karas2420 ingame. I am from South Africa and I would like to as a favor in the next update or a soon to come.

I would like to suggest that you make it possible to download worlds and avatars before hand so it makes it quick and simple when you download it already on steam.
It could be a selective download option within the game its self or full download. Those could be the 2 options that you could do and reason why i ask this of you guys is 1, slow bandwidth. not every1 here can afford fast internet to download as they play so it becomes more of a waiting game than anything else. I myself have a 2MB line which downloads at 220Kbs per second. Yes very slow and you will die.
Other reason is ping and ping is due to the distance of the main server and were in the vast world is located but it still a factor when having to download the world and then whatever avatars spawn in after or during the game. would increase the performance vastly and make the game experience much more enjoyable

I do see it downloads and gets stored int the PC as you go about in the VRchat in the world but you guys are still growing. you have just started and will get much bigger and better soon in time. game is great even though i do not have a VR headset. best i can do is use a xbox one controller or keyboard and mouse. would also like to as what is the best and yet cheap VRheadset you recommend for you game and I suppose its not right to ask but if you got a spare and don't want please send it to me. Hehe. It is extremely expensive here. Well thank you for reading this and I do hope you will do this as it would help those like me.

Kind Regards Jacques Mienie
